failure_symptom: Agent claims bug is fixed without running tests or checking exit code
root_cause: Missing deterministic execution gate between code edit and rule promotion
fix_applied: Always run evlop verify before logging or promoting any engineering lesson

task_summary: Prevent Context Rot during multi-file search
failure_symptom: Main agent context window fills with raw grep/read outputs across 10+ files
root_cause: Running exploratory searches directly inside the primary orchestrator thread
fix_applied: Delegate broad codebase exploration (>5 files) to a read-only subagent that returns a concise synthesis

failure_symptom: UnicodeDecodeError (cp936/gbk) when reading or writing Markdown/JSONL files on Windows
root_cause: Python open() and Path.read_text() default to OS locale encoding when encoding is omitted
fix_applied: Explicitly pass encoding='utf-8' and errors='replace' to all file and subprocess I/O calls

task_summary: Upgrade gene retrieval under stop-word noise
failure_symptom: Recall@1 dropped to 40% when high-fitness distractor genes contained common stop-words
root_cause: Flat unigram token overlap treated stop-words equally with rare diagnostic identifiers
fix_applied: Implement Robertson-Sparck Jones IDF, CJK bigrams, stop-word filtering, and 3x trigger/title field weighting
